io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.pilot_notes: Free pilot: no key, payment, or signup — just call. 20 tasks/service/day shared; anonymous callers share a 40/day fair-use pool (10/day per API key). Live availability at GET /v1/slots. Quota state on ephemeral disk; service sleeps after ~15 min idle. Every deliverable Ed25519-signed; verify offline with the public key in catalog.json. Inputs are processed in server memory only — never logged, stored, sold, or used for training.
